单页排版规划客户端：epoch+pending 串行泵保证一次只有一个 fit_document_one_page 在途，迟到提案按代次丢弃；apply 前 verifyFit 核验 cursor 一致、renderKey/semanticHash 64 位十六进制、attempts 结构与页数边界，且确认受保护字段（字号/行高/边距下限、非排版字段 JSON 等值）。提案经 WeakMap 绑定 epoch，apply 先消费（delete）再以 CAS envelope（commandId/expectedRevision/expectedBranchId/expectedHeadId）提交 setLayout，重复点击不会产生额外 revision。未发现问题。

verifyPreview 对每页 SVG 逐页做 SHA-256 哈希核验 + DOMParser 解析 + 元素/属性黑名单（script/foreignObject/iframe/object/embed/style、on* 属性、非 # 开头的 url() 引用、外链 href/src 仅允许片段、base64 内嵌位图和 a 元素 https/mailto），textMap 链接做协议白名单并拒绝凭据与控制字符，总量限 48MB/200 页。EnginePageCache 以 users 计数 + LRU prune + dispose 管理 blob 对象 URL，users>0 的页不会被逐出，release 幂等；EnginePreviewClient 与 Fit 相同的 epoch 串行泵且 verify 后二次核对 epoch。未发现问题。
纯函数文本命中层：offsetAtPoint 取最近簇并按簇宽度半边与 rtl 标志判定返回 start/end 偏移，selectedText/selectedClusters 做区间过滤，hitRegionAtPoint/linkAtPoint 为包含盒判定（link 要求簇完全落在链接区间内）。无状态、无副作用、无 IPC。未发现问题。

SVG 标志的 WAAPI 手写循环动画：cancelled 标志在每个 await 阶段（每段 Promise.all 与 pause）之后检查，卸载/active 切换的 cleanup 会 cancel 全部动画并重置内联 transform/opacity，循环最多再等完一个 ≤180ms 的 setTimeout 即退出，无未取消动画或定时器泄漏；active 时先检查 prefers-reduced-motion 直接保持静止。未发现问题。

悬浮层纯工具集：measureOverlay 按 visualViewport 尺寸/偏移对 bot/composer/chat 三模式做钳制定位；safeMessage 以 <[^>]*> 去标签并截断（残留文本经 React 转义渲染，无 XSS 面）；sanitizeProposalHtml 复用 utils/resume 白名单并在清空后回退为转义纯文本段落；isLocalModelUrl 经 new URL 精确解析 hostname（仅 http + 127.0.0.1/localhost/[::1]），子域伪装不匹配。未发现问题。

有界 Agent 轮次驱动：≤6 轮模型调用、90 秒预算、48k transcript 字符预算、单回复 ≤4 且累计 ≤12 工具调用，工具 ID 重复/类型无效即抛错，INVALID_ARGUMENT 两次熔断；每轮起点、invoke 返回后与 delta 回调内均检查 AbortSignal，取消经 signal 传播到 invoke 并以 run.cancelled/run.failed 区分事件。工具结果以 JSON 序列化回填 transcript。未发现问题。

findings.issue: Typst website logo still matches github.com/csdn.net as a substring of full shown URL, whereas React WebsiteMark now matches hostname. e.g. github.com.evil.invalid may display GitHub logo in engine output. This affects decorative brand accuracy, not URL navigation or update trust.
findings.recommendation: If logo parity is later changed, pass a validated site-kind from the shared URL formatter; no broad template/visual change in this read-only audit.

findings.issue: prepare_provider computes uses_saved_key only for matching baseUrl/model, but when supplied key is blank it reveals the saved key even if baseUrl/model changed. The browser worker provider_models/provider_test flow forwards this config into a request. A user-triggered changed endpoint can therefore reuse the existing credential.
evidence: browser-fetch.mjs sends bearer header to configured endpoint
findings.recommendation: Clarify whether blank key means reuse across changed endpoints. Restrict saved-key reuse to matching trusted provider identity if that is not intentional. Browser product qualification is parked; no Windows code path/build was changed and no exploitation/runtime assertion is claimed.

issues.evidence: replace_version_store wrappers call transaction directly; branch heads have no FK. UI parser blocks missing heads but direct native IPC previously bypassed this guard. Dangling head does not immediately corrupt load_current while its durable draft remains; original report overstated that symptom.
issues.fix: Validate every supplied non-null head resolves inside replacement commits before mutation. Parent additionally validates parents against same set, blocking cross-document links.
issues.compatibility: UI old missing-parent diagnostics are permissive and useNativeResumeVersions forwards parent unchanged; existing commit_links FK already rejected unresolved parent on native replacement, so new Validation does not remove a previously successful native input. Parent ids linking other documents are now rejected.

issues.evidence: delete_commit and delete_branch deleted commits but retained snapshots and snapshot resource_refs; resource GC considers resource_refs so deleted-history assets leaked.
issues.fix: prune_unreferenced_snapshots executes in each deletion transaction after commit deletion; preserves snapshots still referenced by any commit and removes only snapshot owners whose snapshot is absent.
issues.tests: deleting_history_reclaims_only_unreferenced_snapshots_and_keeps_durable_drafts now asserts real snapshot owner removal; durable draft resource survives actual GC; shared snapshot remains after one commit deletion; final branch deletion releases history assets; main and separate document assets survive

issues.evidence: open_once prepares after verified backup; prepare can fail after migrate transaction commits, so original database was rolled back is not guaranteed. Backup path and diagnostic are retained.
issues.recommendation: Use neutral migration-failure wording that promises only retained verified backup; no migration behavior changes required.

issues.evidence: prepare recovers all running agent rows; additional Store open during a live run is unsafe. Desktop uses one shared Store under mutex; browser host serializes writer lifecycle. Resource-only multi-connection support does not imply agent multi-owner support.
issues.constraint: Host must own agent lifecycle exclusively and must not open a peer Store while an agent run is active.

issues.evidence: graph structure transaction finishes before detail materialization. Peer destructive writes could remove snapshots, but current hosts serialize whole calls.
issues.constraint: Serialize load_version_graph_detailed with peer destructive history writes; existing same-read-transaction doc comment is inaccurate.

issues.evidence: set_document_avatar deletes old owner before potentially failing new FK insert, in separate autocommits; no product callers found, tests only. put_resource second statement can fail after insert, conservatively leaving recovery requirement.
issues.recommendation: If compatibility API gains product use, wrap each pair in transaction and verify replacing with missing hash retains old avatar owner.

issues.evidence: Desktop src-tauri/src/lib.rs:1502 and WASM agent_host.rs:128 call account-scoped load_agent_session and reject missing/foreign sessions before begin_agent_run_with_epoch. Storage API allows synthetic sessions used by existing internal tests.
